adds.title: Supreme Court of Russia ruling November 2023 designating 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist / 22 March 2024 unified list addition
adds.summary: In November 2023 the Supreme Court of Russia designated the 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist and banned it, entered in the unified extremist list on 22 March 2024, prohibiting LGBT including trans organizing, symbols and support in Russia including Sakha Republic under extremism penalties.
